title: Platformer physics
hints: Write the x pass completely and test it with the wall test before writing the y pass: the y pass is the same code with x and y swapped.
The order of the steps matters. The timers must be updated before checking them, and gravity is added after the jump sets the velocity.
requirements: Running accelerates and slows down at the given rates, with less control in the air.
The jump reaches about 92 pixels at 60 steps per second, can be cut short, and works with coyote time and a buffered press.
The player stands on floors, stops at walls and bumps their head on ceilings, and cannot leave the map except by falling.
stretch: Add one-way platforms (solid only when falling onto them from above), ladders, and wall jumping (sliding slowly down a wall and jumping away from it).
